temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia looks more withdrawn than usual at work. When Jose asks if something is wrong, she says it is personal stuff and thanks him for asking, but does not give details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is normally vibrant at work and has no specific reason to think something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He moves from no specific concern to suspecting Patricia may be dealing with a personal problem.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may have a personal issue troubling her and is not ready to share details, but she appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer a listening ear and support without pressing her for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. Patricia then confirms she has been overwhelmed with bills and says she would be interested in discussing financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia may have a personal issue troubling her and appreciates his support, but Jose does not know the nature of the problem.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He identifies financial stress as a concrete source of Patricia's worry, deepening his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially stressed and overwhelmed, and she may welcome help with budgeting or financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, sympathy, and a desire to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to discuss budgeting/financial planning with her and wait for her to take him up on it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose expresses worry that he may have overstepped by bringing up financial planning. Patricia reassures him that he was not prying, says she is grateful, and tells him she appreciates having him as a supportive friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worries he may have overstepped Patricia's boundaries by bringing up finances and is unsure whether she is comfortable with his help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Patricia's reassurance corrects his worry that he overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his support, does not think he was prying, and values him as a friend he can turn to.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief and reassurance after initial worry.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Respect Patricia's privacy while continuing to support her as a friend.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia responds briefly and politely that everything is all good, she plans a quiet weekend at home, and she thanks Jose, saying she will keep his offer in mind.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia welcomes his support and does not mind his concern, so Jose believes he can check in as a supportive friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He senses that she appreciates his concern but is signaling a preference to handle things privately and independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his support but wants privacy, so he should remain available without intruding.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, with some cautious acceptance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain friendly, low-pressure check-ins and availability without pushing for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia tells Jose she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately and independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change. The event confirms that she is managing and values his low-pressure support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation and appreciates his supportive presence, so continued gentle check-ins are appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue offering low-pressure help, such as grabbing coffee, and maintain a supportive presence.
